title: 挑战 2 · 分压器：从 9V 得到 3V
summary: 用两个电阻把 9V 分成 3V，并用电压测试验证。
description:
分压器（voltage divider）是两个串联电阻，从中间点取出一个较低的电压：
  Vout = Vin × R2 / (R1 + R2)

要求：用 9V 电源、R1 = 2kΩ（接 +9V 一侧）、R2 = 1kΩ（接 GND 一侧），使中间节点 VOUT 相对 GND 约为 3V。

验证：9 × 1k / (2k + 1k) = 3V。tests 会测量 VOUT 的电压（2.85–3.15V）。

注意：分压器的输出接上负载以后电压会变（负载和 R2 并联），所以它适合给“几乎不取电流”的东西提供参考电压。

en.title: Challenge 2 · Voltage divider: 3V from 9V
en.summary: Use two resistors to divide 9V down to 3V, and verify it with a voltage test.
en.description:
A voltage divider is two resistors in series, with a lower voltage taken from the point between them:
  Vout = Vin × R2 / (R1 + R2)

Task: with a 9V supply, R1 = 2kΩ (on the +9V side) and R2 = 1kΩ (on the GND side), make the middle node VOUT about 3V relative to GND.

Check: 9 × 1k / (2k + 1k) = 3V. The tests measure the voltage at VOUT (2.85–3.15V).

Note: once you connect a load to a divider's output, the voltage changes (the load is in parallel with R2). So a divider is best for providing a reference voltage to things that draw almost no current.
hints: R1 and R2 are in series; the point where they meet is VOUT.
The larger resistor gets the larger share of the voltage: R1 is twice R2, so R1 gets 6V and R2 gets 3V.
R1 和 R2 串联，中间的连接点就是 VOUT。
大电阻分到的电压多：R1 是 R2 的两倍，所以 R1 上 6V、R2 上 3V。
